Help choose Sigil's letters

Sigil writes hashes and keys as short words, each beginning with a few hex digits and continuing in letters from many scripts. This page tests whether your device's own fonts draw each of the 2,675 candidate letters. It takes a few seconds, runs entirely in your browser, and sends nothing unless you press Send.

Send the result

Send opens a prefilled public issue on GitHub; press Submit there. Or Copy, and paste it into a new issue or a reply to whoever sent you here. The result holds your browser's identification string (its system, browser and their versions) and the letters it could not draw; nothing else.
